title: has_did_sig double-scans headers
description: In lifecycle.rs run_post_pipeline, has_did_sig(article_bytes) is called first (line 538), and if true, extract_did_sig(article_bytes) is called immediately after (line 539). Both functions independently call String::from_utf8_lossy and scan all header lines looking for X-Usenet-IPFS-DID-Sig. This doubles the work: two UTF-8 conversions and two O(n) header scans per POST. Since has_did_sig is implemented as extract_did_sig().is_some(), the fix is trivial: call extract_did_sig once and branch on the Option. Impact is minor (header sections are small, typically under 2KB) but the redundancy is structural.
